panels.title: Most expensive prompts (click prompt_id to inspect, session_id to open the session)
panels.description: One row per user prompt with everything it triggered (main, subagent and auxiliary requests, tool calls); cost_usd is Claude Code's API-equivalent cost. Prompt text is shown only when the client sets OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1, otherwise '(text not logged)'. The actor and skill variables keep only prompts that had a matching request; the totals stay per whole prompt. Sort by clicking a column header.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started, prompt_id, session_id, project,
       if(prompt IN ('', '<REDACTED>'), '(text not logged)', leftUTF8(replaceAll(prompt, '\n', ' '), 200)) AS prompt,
       cost_usd, tokens, requests, tool_calls, agents_run,
       round(max_result_bytes / 1048576, 2) AS max_result_mb,
       input, output, cache_read, cache_creation,
       dateDiff('second', started, last_event) AS seconds
FROM cc.prompts
WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}')
  AND started >= $__fromTime AND started <= $__toTime
  AND (('${actor}' = '__all' AND '${skill}' = '__all') OR (session_id, prompt_id) IN (SELECT session_id, prompt_id FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')))
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Selected prompt
panels.description: Pick a prompt in the Prompt variable above, or click a prompt_id in the ranking. Totals are for the whole prompt and ignore the actor and skill variables. The Prompt list is the top 300 by cost over all time (it ignores the time range and actor/skill); a prompt that started outside the time range shows empty panels. Full text is shown only when the client sets OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started AS time, session_id, project, round(cost_usd, 3) AS cost_usd, tokens, requests, tool_calls,
       if(prompt IN ('', '<REDACTED>'), '(text not logged)', prompt) AS prompt
FROM cc.prompts
WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}')
  AND prompt_id = '${prompt}' AND '${prompt}' != '__all' AND started >= $__fromTime AND started <= $__toTime
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Model requests of the selected prompt
panels.description: Every model request triggered by the selected prompt: main, subagents and auxiliary calls. Not limited by the time range, so events after its right edge are kept; a prompt outside the Prompt list or outside the range of the table above shows nothing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, actor, skill, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens,
       round(cost_usd, 4) AS cost_usd, duration_ms
FROM cc.api_requests
WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}')
  AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')
  AND prompt_id = '${prompt}' AND '${prompt}' != '__all'
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Tool calls of the selected prompt
panels.description: Every tool call triggered by the selected prompt, with the project-relative path (or the first word of a Bash command). Not limited by the time range, so events after its right edge are kept; a prompt outside the Prompt list shows nothing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, actor, skill, tool_name, success, duration_ms,
       if(path != '', path, bash_cmd) AS target
FROM cc.tool_calls
WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}')
  AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')
  AND prompt_id = '${prompt}' AND '${prompt}' != '__all'
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 500
